sql: SELECT d.date AS ds, SUM(d.total_passengers) AS y FROM daily_passenger_stats AS d WHERE d.route_id = '58' AND TRIM(d.operator) = 'HTX-VTHANG' GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY ds ASC;
sql_explanation: This SQL query selects the daily total passengers for bus route 58 operated by HTX-VTHANG, which will be used to forecast the next 7 days.
